description: Finish signing in after connect(email). The person must review the linked terms and tick the acknowledgement on their email confirmation page themselves. Never accept for them. Then call with request_id and no code, or the code they read you. A terms_acknowledgement_required state needs that human action; do not keep retrying. Also takes a key the user already holds (api_key) to use that account here.

api_key.description: A key the user already holds (`avk_...`, or an earlier `dic_...`), to use that account in this conversation. Not needed after an email sign-in.
api_key.title: Api Key

code.description: The six-digit code from the email, only if the user reads it to you instead of clicking Confirm.
code.title: Code

request_id.description: The `request_id` that `connect(email=...)` returned. Call right away with no code: it waits for the user's Confirm click.
request_id.title: Request Id

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: connect_verify
title: Finish signing in
